# Setup

How do I set up the project?

1. Install Node 24 or newer.
2. Run the entry point.

```sh
node index.mjs; echo $ done
```

The snippet `a; b` and the [overview](../README.md#quick-start) stay untouched.

Node resolves the entry point as an [ES module](https://nodejs.org/api/esm.html;v=1).
